# Developers — Shivanshu Tiwari

> Developer surface for shivanshutiwari.in — markdown twins, sitemap, agent catalogs.

## Quickstart

- [Developers portal](https://shivanshutiwari.in/developers): quickstart + endpoints + auth
- [Main llms.txt](https://shivanshutiwari.in/llms.txt)
- [Sitemap](https://shivanshutiwari.in/sitemap.xml) — 30+ URLs
- [Agent skills](https://shivanshutiwari.in/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## Endpoints

- `GET /sitemap.xml`
- `Accept: text/markdown` on any page or `/path.md`
- `GET /.well-known/api-catalog` (RFC 9727)
